overview: The single 4.2 cm Famennian holotype AM5750 preserves an oral disc and branchial basket, documenting lamprey-grade anatomy in the total group.

ecology.diet: The oral disc and teeth do not by themselves establish parasitism; feeding mode is undetermined.
ecology.habitat: The fossil comes from the Waterloo Farm depositional setting. The animal’s habitat in life was not directly observed.
ecology.locomotion: Its elongate body supports a swimming interpretation, but locomotor performance was not measured.
ecology.bodySize: The holotype measures 4.2 cm; no broader size range is established.
ecology.dietZh: 口吸盘和牙齿本身不能证明寄生；取食方式尚未确定。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自 Waterloo Farm 的沉积环境；动物生前的栖地没有被直接观察到。
ecology.locomotionZh: 细长身体支持其能够游泳的解释，但没有测定运动表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 正模长 4.2 厘米；现有证据不能确定更广的体型范围。

evidenceSummary: AM5750 directly records lamprey-grade anatomy, but one fossil does not set the first appearance of crown lampreys or preserve a life cycle or feeding behavior.
overviewZh: 唯一一件法门期正模 AM5750 长 4.2 厘米，保存了口吸盘和鳃篮，为全群层级的七鳃鳗型解剖提供证据。
traitsZh: 口周围保存有 14 枚牙齿。
evidenceSummaryZh: AM5750 直接记录了七鳃鳗型解剖，但单件化石不能确定冠群七鳃鳗的首现，也没有保存其生活史或取食行为。

overview: Two Carboniferous Myxinikela siroka fossils preserve an elongated, scaleless body and soft-tissue traces. Their revised anatomy combines general cyclostome features with specializations compared with living hagfishes.

ecology.habitat: Francis Creek Shale depositional setting; life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Elongate aquatic swimmer; performance not measured

evidenceSummary: FMNH PF15373 and PF8472 support a stem or possible total-group hagfish interpretation. Some structures remain uncertain, and the specimens are outside the crown-Myxini fossil range.

title.en: Two specimens and a preserved body outline
title.zh: 两件标本与保存的身体轮廓

text.en: The holotype and paratype, FMNH PF15373 and PF8472, measure about 62.5–73.3 mm in the represented material. They preserve an elongated, scaleless body outline and soft-tissue traces from the Francis Creek Shale.
text.zh: 正模和副模 FMNH PF15373、PF8472 所代表的身体长约 62.5–73.3 毫米。它们来自 Francis Creek 页岩，保存了无鳞的细长身体轮廓及软组织痕迹。

title.en: A hagfish-like pattern with open questions
title.zh: 具有盲鳗特征但仍有疑问

text.en: The revised description compares the fossils with cyclostomes—lampreys and hagfishes—and identifies specializations resembling hagfish anatomy. The authors place Myxinikela on the stem, or possibly within the total group, of hagfishes. Some features remain equivocal, so this is not a crown-hagfish record.
text.zh: 修订后的描述将化石与圆口类（七鳃鳗和盲鳗）比较，并指出若干类似盲鳗的特化结构。作者将 Myxinikela 放在盲鳗干群，或可能位于盲鳗总群内。部分结构仍难以判定，因此这不是冠群盲鳗的化石记录。

overviewZh: 两件石炭纪 Myxinikela siroka 化石保存了细长、无鳞的身体及软组织痕迹。修订后的解剖描述结合了盲鳗类的一般特征，以及与现生盲鳗相比的特化特征。

overview: A complete soft-bodied hagfish, BHI 6445, comes from the Cenomanian Hâdjoula Lagerstätte in Lebanon. A morphology-based analysis places it within crown Myxini, although its exact branch position depends on the matrix.

ecology.habitat: The specimen comes from a marine Tethyan Lagerstätte; its life habitat is not resolved.
ecology.locomotion: Its body is elongate, but the fossil does not measure swimming performance.
ecology.bodySize: Complete body fossil; size follows the figured holotype
ecology.locomotionZh: 其身体细长，但化石不能测量游泳表现。

evidenceSummary: BHI 6445 supplies a complete anatomical sample and a Cenomanian fossil bound for crown hagfishes. One specimen does not establish their global first appearance, ecology or uninterrupted range.

title.en: A whole hagfish preserved in the Cretaceous
title.zh: 白垩纪保存的完整盲鳗

text.en: The holotype BHI 6445 is a complete soft-bodied hagfish from the Cenomanian Hâdjoula Lagerstätte of Lebanon, in the eastern Tethys. Its feeding apparatus and body characters were included in a published morphology-based phylogenetic analysis. That analysis places Tethymyxine tapirostrum within crown Myxini, the group containing living hagfishes, though the exact branch changes with the matrix. The 100.5–93.9 Ma interval is the sampled fossil envelope for this specimen, not a global origin date.
text.zh: 正模 BHI 6445 是一具来自黎巴嫩 Hâdjoula 特异埋藏群的完整软体盲鳗，地点位于东特提斯。研究者把它的取食器官和身体性状纳入形态系统发育分析；该分析将 Tethymyxine tapirostrum 置于包含现生盲鳗的盲鳗纲冠群内，但具体分支位置会随矩阵变化。100.5–93.9 Ma 是这件标本的化石年代包络，不是全球起源日期。

title.en: A fossil is not a record of modern hagfish behaviour
title.zh: 化石没有记录现生盲鳗的行为

text.en: The marine deposit documents where BHI 6445 was buried, but the specimen does not directly establish diet, scavenging, preferred depth or the ecology of living hagfishes. One locality also cannot define the group's global distribution. The fossil therefore supports a bounded anatomical and phylogenetic comparison, not a complete ecological profile or a continuous history of the crown group.
text.zh: 海相沉积记录说明 BHI 6445 埋藏于何种地质背景，却不能直接确定它的食性、食腐行为或偏好水深，也不能代替对现生盲鳗生态的研究。一个地点同样无法定义该类群的全球分布。因此，这件化石支持范围有限的解剖与系统发育比较，而不是完整的生态画像或冠群连续历史。

title.en: Miyashita et al. (2019), Cretaceous Tethys hagfish
title.zh: Miyashita 等（2019），特提斯海白垩纪盲鳗

scope.en: BHI 6445, its Hâdjoula horizon and locality, Figures 1–3, Supplementary Figures S1–S4 and the morphology-based phylogenetic analysis. This source supports the specimen-scoped Cenomanian bound; it does not provide a global hagfish origin date or direct behavioural observations.
scope.zh: BHI 6445、Hâdjoula 层位与地点、图 1–3、补充图 S1–S4 及形态系统发育分析。该来源支持限定于标本的森诺曼期年代包络；它不提供盲鳗全球起源日期或直接行为观察。

overviewZh: 一条保存完整软体的盲鳗，标本 BHI 6445，来自黎巴嫩塞诺曼期 Hâdjoula 特异埋藏化石库。基于形态的分析将其置于盲鳗冠群内，但其确切分支位置取决于矩阵。
evidenceSummaryZh: BHI 6445 提供了完整的解剖样本，并为冠群盲鳗提供了一个森诺曼期化石年代界限。一件标本无法确定其全球最早出现时间、生态或连续分布范围。

geography: Lianghe village, Yongdong town, Xiushan County, Chongqing Municipality
Kapeng Reservoir, Baojing County, Xiangxi, Hunan
overview: Articulated Tujiaaspis vividus specimens from the Huixingshao Formation preserve three unpaired dorsal fins, a near-symmetrical hypochordal tail and ventrolateral fins extending from the branchial region toward the tail. A model tests passive lift from those fins, but does not measure swimming performance or establish the fish’s life habitat.

ecology.diet: Diet is not determined by the articulated specimens.
ecology.habitat: The Huixingshao Formation records the fossils’ depositional setting, not a resolved living habitat.
ecology.locomotion: A model estimates passive lift from reconstructed ventrolateral fins; swimming performance was not measured.
ecology.bodySize: The cited material does not support a single genus-wide body-length estimate.
ecology.guild: The cited study does not resolve an ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 关节相连的标本不能确定食性。
ecology.locomotionZh: 模型根据重建的腹外侧鳍估算了被动升力；研究未测量游泳能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所引材料不足以支持该属统一的体长估计。
ecology.guildZh: 所引研究未能确定生态类群。

traits: The specimens preserve three unpaired dorsal fins.
The tail is described as approximately symmetrical and hypochordal.
Ventrolateral fins form a continuous outline from the branchial region toward the caudal region.
evidenceSummary: Holotype IVPP V26668 and paratypes IVPP V27410–V27411 anchor the postcranial observations. The 438.6–432.9 Ma interval belongs to the sampled Huixingshao Formation horizon; it is not a global range, direct ancestry date or universal fin-evolution sequence.
overviewZh: 来自 Huixingshao 组的 Tujiaaspis vividus 关节相连标本保存了三枚不成对背鳍、近乎对称的下脊索尾，以及从鳃区向尾部延伸的腹外侧鳍。一项模型检验这些鳍能否产生被动升力，但没有测量游泳表现，也不能确定鱼生活时的栖地。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模 IVPP V26668 和副模 IVPP V27410–V27411 是后躯观察的依据。438.6–432.9 Ma 属于所取样的 Huixingshao 组层位；它不是全球分布范围、直接祖先年代或普遍的鳍演化序列。

readerSources.title: Galeaspid anatomy and the origin of vertebrate paired appendages

scope.en: Gai et al. (2022), pp. 959–963, Figures 1–4 and Extended Data Figures 1–6: articulated specimens, fin anatomy, sampled localities and a computed passive-lift model; no swimming performance was measured.
scope.zh: Gai 等（2022），第 959–963 页、图 1–4 与扩展数据图 1–6：关节相连标本、鳍的解剖、取样地点及被动升力计算模型；研究未测量游泳表现。

title.en: Ventral fins and a passive-lift model
title.zh: 腹外侧鳍与被动升力模型

text.en: Articulated Tujiaaspis vividus specimens from the Huixingshao Formation preserve three unpaired dorsal fins, a near-symmetrical hypochordal tail and ventrolateral fins extending from the branchial region toward the tail. A model tests passive lift from those fins, but does not measure swimming performance or establish the fish’s life habitat.
text.zh: 来自 Huixingshao 组的 Tujiaaspis vividus 关节相连标本保存了三枚不成对背鳍、近乎对称的下脊索尾，以及从鳃区向尾部延伸的腹外侧鳍。一项模型检验这些鳍能否产生被动升力，但没有测量游泳表现，也不能确定鱼生活时的栖地。

title.en: The Huixingshao sample and its age window
title.zh: Huixingshao 样本及其年代区间

text.en: Holotype IVPP V26668 and paratypes IVPP V27410–V27411 anchor the postcranial observations. The 438.6–432.9 Ma interval belongs to the sampled Huixingshao Formation horizon; it is not a global range, direct ancestry date or universal fin-evolution sequence.
text.zh: 正模 IVPP V26668 和副模 IVPP V27410–V27411 是后躯观察的依据。438.6–432.9 Ma 属于所取样的 Huixingshao 组层位；它不是全球分布范围、直接祖先年代或普遍的鳍演化序列。

traitsZh: 标本保存了三枚不成对的背鳍。
其尾部被描述为近似对称且具下脊索。
腹外侧鳍形成一条连续轮廓，从鳃区延伸至尾区。

overview: Xiushanosteus mirabilis is anchored by an articulated holotype and more than twenty referred bodies from the Chongqing Lagerstätte. Its small, armoured body and mosaic skull roof contribute to a Telychian record of early jawed vertebrates.

ecology.habitat: Huixingshao Formation depositional setting; life habitat remains unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic body preservation; swimming performance was not measured
ecology.bodySize: Approximately 30 mm in the figured articulated material

evidenceSummary: IVPP V300001 and referred IVPP V300002–V300021 preserve articulated anatomy. The sample does not establish a global first appearance, direct ancestry or a complete history of placoderms.

title.zh: 关节相连化石中的甲胄

text.en: Holotype IVPP V300001 and referred specimens IVPP V300002–V300021 preserve articulated bodies about 30 mm long, including cranial armour. Their skull roofs combine character states described as a mosaic in the study.
text.zh: 正模 IVPP V300001 和归入标本 IVPP V300002–V300021 保存了约 30 毫米长的关节相连身体，其中包括头部甲胄。研究将其头顶骨组合描述为兼有不同类型特征的镶嵌。

title.en: A window onto an early jawed-vertebrate sample
title.zh: 早期有颌脊椎动物样本的一扇窗口

text.en: The fossils come from the Telychian Huixingshao Formation and are interpreted as a jawed stem gnathostome. A Lagerstätte can preserve many individuals from one setting; that concentration does not make Xiushanosteus a direct ancestor or the first jawed vertebrate worldwide. The formation’s depositional setting is not a direct measure of preferred habitat.
text.zh: 这些化石来自特列奇期的 Huixingshao 组，研究将其解释为有颌类干群成员。化石库可以在一个地点保存许多个体，但这种集中保存不表示 Xiushanosteus 是直系祖先或全球最早的有颌脊椎动物。地层的沉积环境也不能直接说明它偏好的栖地。

overviewZh: Xiushanosteus mirabilis 的依据包括一件关节相连的正模和重庆生物群中的二十多件归入标本。其小型披甲身体和呈镶嵌状的头顶骨，为特列奇期早期有颌脊椎动物记录增添了材料。
evidenceSummaryZh: IVPP V300001 及归入该种的 IVPP V300002–V300021 保存了关节相连的解剖结构。这批样本不能确定全球最早出现时间、直接祖先关系或盾皮鱼类的完整历史。
